name: Prayer Private
overview: Prayer in private is exemplified in Scripture as a heartfelt appeal to God for guidance, protection, and blessing, as seen in the prayers of Jacob who earnestly sought deliverance from his brother and trusted in God's promises. The sample verses from Genesis reveal a personal and humble approach to God, acknowledging unworthiness yet confidently requesting help and favor. These prayers reflect a deep reliance on God's faithfulness and mercy, demonstrating that private prayer is a vital expression of trust and dependence on the Lord.
